metadata.description: Print prepress box model, bleed boundaries, 300 DPI calculations, TAC limits, and Rich Black

boundary.name: trim_box
boundary.description: Exact physical dimension of printed document after cutting (e.g. EU Business Card: 85x55mm, A4: 210x297mm)

boundary.name: bleed_box
boundary.description: Extra margin (typically 3mm or 0.125in) extending outward from trim line. Backgrounds MUST extend here to prevent white paper slivers.

boundary.name: safe_zone
boundary.description: Inner margin (3-5mm inside trim line). Critical typography, logos, and QR codes must remain inside.

cmyk_and_press_rules.gamut_mismatch: RGB colors with high saturation (neon green, electric cyan) cannot be reproduced in standard 4-color process inks.
cmyk_and_press_rules.tac_limit: Total Area Coverage (C% + M% + Y% + K%) must not exceed 300% on coated paper to prevent smearing.
cmyk_and_press_rules.pure_black: Mandatory for all body text and thin lines to eliminate misregistration fringing.
cmyk_and_press_rules.rich_black: Used for solid dark backgrounds for deep, luxurious black without gray cast.
